find character where name = "Dwight Conrad" as dwight
follow dwight hasMother obj as mother
follow mother hasSpouse obj as spouse
keep mother where spouse.name = "Hermes Conrad"
return mother.name, mother.creator

find location where name = "Twins" as loc
follow loc bornIn character as c
return c.name

find character where name = "Petyr Baelish" as killer
follow killer killedBy subj as victim
follow victim bornIn location as birthplace
keep victim where birthplace.name = "Riverrun"
return victim.name

find character as c
follow c hasFather obj as father
return distinct c.country_of_citizenship
